headline: AT&T highlights advanced broadband and wireless customer bundling
summary: AT&T noted that a significant share of its advanced home-internet customers also bundle its mobile wireless service.
why: Customer bundling strategies help telecom providers reduce churn, increase average revenue per user, and solidify long-term subscriber loyalty.
